papers.t: Extraradical Mycorrhizal Hyphae Promote Soil Carbon Sequestration through Difficultly Extractable Glomalin-Related Soil Protein in Response to Soil Water Stress
Soil phosphorus compared to nitrogen limitation increases the uncertainty of subsoil organic carbon sequestration in Pinus massoniana mixed forests
Arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi and earthworms synergistically enhance trifoliate orange growth by regulating auxins and promote soil organic carbon sequestration through soil glomalin
